name: AU, AN, AS, AP, AC Series Gasketed Plate Heat Exchanger - I
full_description: The AU, AN, AS, AP, AC Series Gasketed Plate Heat Exchanger - I is designed for industrial applications where high heat transfer efficiency, cost-effectiveness, safety, reliability, and ease of maintenance are required. Accessen states that the series uses glue-free clip-on gaskets and multiple specialized plate patterns to cover a wide range of capacities, fluid qualities, and operating temperatures.
advantage: Optimized plate size and angle combinations
Strong turbulence for enhanced heat transfer

technical_parameters.Temperature: Minimum temperature difference: 0.5-1℃, Maximum temperature resistance: 200℃

details.title: What makes this industrial gasketed series flexible?
details.content: Accessen highlights the use of multiple plate angles, groove depths, and aspect ratios within the same port size so the exchanger can be adapted to different industrial duties and operating conditions.

details.title: How does it support easier maintenance?
details.content: The design uses glue-free clip-on gaskets, improved flow distribution, and plate corner alignment features to simplify servicing and help reduce fouling-related downtime.

seo_data.meta_description: Industrial gasketed plate heat exchanger with configurable plate geometry, glue-free gaskets, and high heat transfer efficiency for demanding process applications.
